title: Replace Paperclip with the in-repository task tracker
body:
ADR 0015 records the shipped Git-backed `tasks/<id>.json` tracker, its `krn task` commands, and the no-import decision. Product Paperclip was removed in #109; GLOBAL forwarding is shipped in #457 and #459, and claim mutations use the kernel-held per-task lock in #110.
Delivered: #111 recorded the tracker, routing and repository rules and seeded follow-up work in `tasks/`; GLOBAL removed its Paperclip integration in krn-works/krn-codex-skills #461 (t-yxxfg7k). Paperclip and legacy queue data are not imported; the host Paperclip service and data stay untouched pending a separate operator decision.
